## Logia Invulnerability Ame

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/logia_invulnerability_ame.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

Whoever hits the user's syrup body in close combat without Haki is stuck in place for a moment. The user's punches hit harder on an enemy stuck in the syrup. A hit with wheat or bread in hand, or one of them thrown at the user, covers the user in flour. For a while every hit lands on the syrup body, and it holds nobody.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| --- | --- |
| Pack multiplier when dealing damage | 2.3× |

</div>

## Syrup Spear

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/syrup_spear.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user's arm stretches far ahead into a spear of hardened syrup. It pierces every enemy in a line and leaves them stuck for a moment. The user's arm stretches far ahead and catches the first enemy in its way. The enemy is brought back stuck against the user's syrup body.

## Spike Burst

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/spike_burst.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Spikes of hardened syrup shoot out of the user's whole body. Every enemy around is hit and thrown back. Covered in spikes of hardened syrup, the user dashes forward. Every enemy on the way is hit and thrown aside.

## Slingshot

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/slingshot.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

While the key is held, the user's syrup body stretches back like a slingshot. When it is let go, the body snaps forward and throws the user where they look. The longer it is held, the farther the leap and the harder the blow. The first enemy in the way is struck and stuck in the syrup.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| --- | --- |
| Cooldown | 8 s (160 ticks) |
| Full cooldown | 12 s (240 ticks) |
| Pack multiplier when dealing damage | 2.3× |

</div>

## Syrup Pool

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/syrup_pool.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user spreads a pool of syrup on the ground where the user is looking. Whoever steps in it is stuck. Using it again hardens the pool into spikes that hit every enemy standing in it.
